note: Generated by write_period_null_table (longterm/null_tests.rs), fixed seeds. 400 draws a cell for the mean and as many for the maximum. The maximum's generalised extreme value by maximum likelihood: location and scale for each cell (the scale's relative error about 4%); the shape profiled over 0 to 0.3 in steps of 0.02, shared by each take length and step (readings) or each mix (timing). The drawn mixes are white, 1 to 10^4 up to 0.35 of the sampling rate, and walk; above white, each is drawn with flicker of the rate at shares 0, 0.01, 0.1 and 1 of the red-white crossover (1: flicker alone, no walk), read between in log share, and linearly from none to 0.01 (#1219). The drawn mixes reach both ends of the lookup's axis, white and walk, so no fitted mix lies past them. Timing's maxima are each levelled as a take is, at the mix and flicker share its own search fitted. Timing's location and scale are fitted to the maxima grouped by the mix and flicker share each take's search fitted, which is the coordinate the lookup reads, pooled from every drawn cell of that length and step. A cell that fewer than 200 draws read takes the 200 read nearest it. Each cell's tail is then the least favourable over the drawn cells (mix and flicker share) read as it or a neighbour on either axis (the lookup blends neighbours): fitted to the drawn cell, of those giving at least 50 draws, whose maxima most often pass the fit's p 0.001 and 0.0003 levels, refitted until that cell is the one fitted, and sharing its shape group. So the false-alarm chance holds for every drawn mix and share, not on average over them. Timing's mean and gamma shape at each x are read least favourable the same way: the highest mean and the lowest shape over the drawn cells (of those with at least 50 draws there) read as the cell or a neighbour on either axis, since the fit reads the mix only at x of 2 and above. Each bin's whitened power is scored by its own null spread (a gamma shape per x). Each timing cell also gives a misfit limit: the misfit is the rms in decades of the quarter-octave band powers from the walk, flicker and white fitted to them, and the limit is the 99th percentile of it (2000 draws a drawn mix), the largest over the drawn cells (of those with at least 50 draws there) read as this cell or a neighbour. Pooled tail check: 2464 of 234058 null maxima under p 0.01 (expected 2341), 519 under 0.001 (expected 234).
